articles.title: Iraq Shuts Sheeb Border Crossing With Iran Under U.S. Pressure, Reports Say
articles.description: Iraqi authorities closed the Sheeb border crossing with Iran on Wednesday, Oct. 21, according to sources cited by Western media outlets. The closure of the busy commercial and passenger gateway in southern Iraq marks the latest front in what multiple reports describe as intensified U.S. pressure on Baghdad to isolate Tehran economically [6].
